profile.headline: Web Application Developer | C#, JavaScript, SQL, RESTful/SOAP APIs | Building Scalable Web Applications & APIs
profile.summary: A full-stack .NET developer with a strong focus on utilizing C# across both the front-end (ASP.NET Core MVC) and back-end (SQL Server). Adept at creating complete web solutions, from user interface design and server-side logic to database management and API integration.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: The Woodlands, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
API Development: Designed, developed, and maintained RESTful/SOAP APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API (or similar .NET technologies) to facilitate efficient data exchange and integration between internal and external systems.
Full-Stack Development: Leveraged C# with ASP.NET Core MVC to design and develop user-friendly, server-rendered web interfaces. Built robust back-end logic using C# and Microsoft SQL Server, ensuring seamless data flow and integration with front-end components enhanced by JavaScript for dynamic interactions.
Version Control: Collaborated effectively within agile teams using Git-based platforms such as GitHub and Azure DevOps for comprehensive code management, version control, and streamlined development workflows.
positions.insights: C#, Microsoft SQL Server and +7 skills

positions.title: Library Technical Assistant
positions.description:
Providing customer services such as assisting in finding an item and using library equipment. 
Maintaining library equipment such as desktop, laptop, printers, and copiers.
Updating and maintaining items' records in the database using Sierra ILS software.

positions.title: Computer Science Student
positions.description:
Currency Exchange Checker (Spring 2017):
Designed and implemented a software using Java to notify users when a currency pair reaches the target rate.

Database (Fall 2016):
Creating a database using MySQL to store information such as customer's orders, and products' details.
Displaying database using JSP, PHP, and ASP. 

Tetris (Fall 2016):
Cooperated with a team to design and implement a tile-matching puzzle game using C++.

positions.title: Web Design Intern
positions.description: Learning new programming languages: PHP, HTML, and CSS to assist in developing a WordPress plugin, Buoy.

honors.title: Texas Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (T-STEM) Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by Houston Community College · Jan 2014
